STRATEGY: Parent is an adaptive IPD strategy that starts cooperating, retaliates to defection, and forgives when opponent's overall cooperation rate is high. The trace simulates the parent and population slots against candidate patterns (always defect, always cooperate, alternating D/C, last-round defection, probing). It plans to revise by adding early probing to classify opponents as strict retaliators vs forgiving, then exploit forgiving opponents with higher defection rates while cooperating with strict TFT until the final round.

STRATEGY: The parent is an adaptive strategy that cooperates when opponent cooperation rate is high, forgives when it is moderately high, and retaliates otherwise. The trace simulates the parent and population members (always C, always D, TFT-like, forgiving slot4) to estimate scores. It proposes replacing the parent with a probe-and-exploit state machine: cooperate early, defect to test tolerance, then either exploit forgiving opponents or cooperate until the last round against retaliators.
